nodes.name: Context Map.md
nodes.summary: Root structural artifact of the dev_graph defining 6 bounded contexts (Data Pipeline, Trading Engine, Risk Control, Agent Runtime, Evaluation Loop, Supervisor Office) and the 8 cross-system interfaces that connect them, with a Mermaid flowchart and system boundary table.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph node of type 'architecture' (canonical_id: ARCH-001, architecture_type: context_map). Serves as the entry point for all engineering sessions — every system node references this map.

nodes.name: Infrastructure Diagram.md
nodes.summary: Full-stack infrastructure topology diagram showing all substrates (raw/, wiki/, dev_graph/), MCP servers (mcpvault, smart-connections, context7, neo4j, postgres), databases (Neo4j, PostgreSQL), Obsidian plugins, and Claude Code session components, with annotated data-flow arrows rendered in Mermaid.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph node of type 'architecture' (canonical_id: ARCH-004, architecture_type: context_map). Supersedes earlier root-level infrastructure diagram. Provides onboarding reference for new Claude Code sessions.

nodes.name: Layer Model.md
nodes.summary: Formal definition of the three-layer trading pipeline architecture (L1 Data Ingestion, L2 Analysis/Strategy, L3 Execution) with per-layer responsibilities, data contracts, failure modes, and a system-to-layer mapping table; identifies the Layer 2 Snapshot Schema as the critical inter-layer data contract.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph node of type 'architecture' (canonical_id: ARCH-003, architecture_type: layer_model). Vertical decomposition complement to the horizontal bounded-context decomposition in Context Map.

nodes.name: Runtime Topology.md
nodes.summary: Dynamic component-interaction model showing how all 6 systems communicate at runtime via 12 named events (SnapshotCreated through UpgradeDecided), expressed as a Mermaid sequence diagram, an event-flow summary table, and a runtime scheduling table by time-of-day.
nodes.languageNotes: Dev_graph node of type 'architecture' (canonical_id: ARCH-002, architecture_type: runtime_topology). Complements Context Map's static structure with dynamic event-driven runtime behavior; event nodes will be created in Phase 7.
